spec.title: Static against dynamic partitioning under an exogenous queue
spec.notes: The thesis's central experiment, transposed: partition size against worker count, measuring CCR, load imbalance and achieved speed-up. Where CCR exceeds one the coarse window should win, which is the opposite of what the DAG scheduling literature predicts — it assumes calls are free to make. Five repeats because the queue is someone else's traffic.
